messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: anomalous token accounting spike for tenant `altumcorp` detected in vpc-dedicated-pool-02. Delta vs expected usage: +1,200,000 tokens over 10m. Source: billing-metering-service. Severity: P2. Runbook: incidents/token-accounting.
Lara (SRE - oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Adding Devin & Priya. Assigning workspace to SRE until containment.
Devin (Billing): On call for billing. Seeing the alert too. Can you dump the raw meter events for altumcorp for the last 15m? I want to check duplicate writes vs emitted tokens.
Lara (SRE - oncall): Pulling now. `/svc/logs query "tenant:altumcorp AND meter_event" --ago 15m | jq .` Getting a lot of repeated reconcile entries and some 500s from metering-write.
Tom (Runtime): I can see a burst of requests and a restart event on the dedicated pool around the same time: `dpool-02-autoscaler` triggered a scale-out, one node failed healthcheck and kube restarted the pod. KV cache flushes were observed.
Priya (Customer Success): Heads-up — AltumCorp is a paying enterprise on Dedicated VPC with committed capacity. They're in region eu-west-1. I'll prepare standby comms, but want to avoid notifying until we know customer impact.
Alex (Infra): Dump of metering DB writes (redwood_meter.events) shows 1,218,432 events for tenant_id altumcorp with identical request_id hashes repeated 3x each. Looks like a write-retry loop caused duplicates at the ingestion layer.
Devin (Billing): That explains the spike. If events are triplicated, token counts will be inflated by x3. Need to verify if these were purely duplicate ingests or if tokens were actually consumed by runtime.
Lara (SRE - oncall): Quick check on runtime token counters: `/metrics/tenant/altumcorp/tokens_consumed?window=1h` shows normal consumption curve, no 3x spike. So consumption wasn't triple — it's a metering ingestion problem. Good.
Tom (Runtime): The pod restart caused a short KV prefix cache invalidation; client SDKs retry on transient 502s. It looks like the SDK retry logic doesn't de-dupe identical request ids before re-emitting to the metering endpoint when the write returns 502 during the first attempt.
Maya (SRE - followup): Copying proposed containment steps: 1) Stop metering write ingestion for altumcorp (write-path throttle) 2) Run de-dup reconciliation job to compute canonical token consumption from runtime counters + raw request logs 3) Patch SDK to ensure idempotent writes (short fix) 4) Customer ledger adjustment if needed. Approve to start (2) while (1) in flight?
Devin (Billing): Approve. Start reconciliation immediately and hold outbound billing invoices for altumcorp until we complete. Also need audit trail for any modifications.
Priya (Customer Success): Please add me to the reconciliation run. I'll need the draft customer notice and the expected time to resolution.
Lara (SRE - oncall): Initiating containment: applying a write-throttle rule to metering-ingestion for tenant altumcorp: `POST /ops/rate-limits {"tenant":"altumcorp","path":"/meter/write","limit":5/s}` — applied. No new duplicate events observed in the live stream after 90s.
incidents-bot: System note: rate limit applied by Lara at 2026-03-15T14:03:12Z.
Devin (Billing): Running reconciliation script: `redwood-meter-reconcile --tenant altumcorp --start "2026-03-15T13:30:00Z" --end "2026-03-15T14:30:00Z" --dedupe-policy=request_id` (dry-run first). Output: total_raw_events=1,218,432, unique_request_ids=406,142, dedup_ratio=3.0, runtime_reported_tokens=402,120. Suspected overcount = raw_tokens - runtime_tokens = ~1,816,000 tokens. (dry-run, not writing ledger yet)
Tom (Runtime): Confirming runtime token emission matches deduped count: logs show tokens_emitted_sum ~402,450. Within tolerances. So deduped ingestion aligns with runtime.
Alex (Infra): Root cause timeline so far: 13:59 UTC autoscaler bumped dpool-02; one metering ingestion instance returned 502 during transient DB leader election; SDK retried with immediate retry policy and request_id not persisted locally -> multiple writes landed when leader recovered. Also healthcheck flapping caused a brief double-emission by the sidecar.
Maya (SRE - followup): Short-term mitigation: keep write-throttle in place and deploy a hotfix to metering-ingestion that de-duplicates by request_id at ingestion layer (stateless bloom-filter for 2 minutes) — low-risk rollout to canary then global. Medium-term: SDK idempotency fix + stronger backoff. Estimate for hotfix rollout: 45m to canary, 2h to full.
Devin (Billing): For customer-facing ledger: we will compute adjustment = runtime_reported_tokens - billed_tokens_during_window. For window above, billed_tokens (raw) = sum(raw_event.tokens) = 2,218,120 (example), runtime_reported_tokens = 402,450 => credit = 1,815,670 tokens. I'll prepare invoice hold and credit entry draft.
Priya (Customer Success): ETA for customer comms? If we have a reconciliation number in 60m I can send an interim note: "We're investigating an ingestion duplication issue affecting telemetry; no extra runtime compute billed to you; we're reconciling and will apply a credit if needed". Want to keep tone calm. :+1:
Lara (SRE - oncall): Handoff to Maya for cleanup + postmortem. I'm rotating off in 20m but will remain reachable for questions. Handoff notes: containment done (throttle), reconciliation running (Devin), runtime unaffected, customer comms queued.
Maya (SRE - followup): Taking over. I'll monitor canary deploy for dedupe filter and coordinate infra rollback if false positives. Creating incident tracker: `INC-2026-0456` and adding timeline entries. I'll also capture the autoscaler logs to see why the node flapped.
incidents-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-0456. Pager status: acknowledged — owner: Maya (SRE - followup).
Devin (Billing): Reconciliation dry-run complete. I'll re-run in write mode after Maya confirms dedupe filter is stabilizing. Will not modify customer ledger until we have +2 approvals (Billing lead + CS). Preparing ledger patch and audit note.
Priya (Customer Success): Please include an explicit note: we will not charge anything extra and will proactively credit. I'll draft the customer message and circulate for approval when numbers finalized.
Tom (Runtime): Also adding a small follow-up fix: client SDKs should attach a persistent local request_id cache so retries within 30s reuse same id. I'll open PR and target patch release in 48h.
Maya (SRE - followup): Canary of ingestion dedupe filter deployed (canary: metering-ingest-v2-canary). Early metrics: dedupe rate 99.7% on replayed events, no increased error rates. Promoting to regional rollout in 30m if stable.
Lara (SRE - oncall): Thanks team — leaving the on-call rotation. Good job on containment. I'll join postmortem tomorrow.
Devin (Billing): Final note for now: blocking invoices for AltumCorp for this billing period until reconciliation completes. I will annotate the billing system with incident id INC-2026-0456.
Priya (Customer Success): Draft message ready (internal): "Interim: we've detected duplicated telemetry that inflated usage numbers for a short period. We're reconciling and will issue any necessary credits. No action required on your side." Sending after final numbers. Will update customer in 90m.
Maya (SRE - followup): Next steps logged in tracker: 1) finish dedupe rollout 2) run final reconcile (write mode) 3) prepare ledger adjustment + audit 4) CS customer note + sync 5) postmortem and long-term SDK fix. Target: full resolution in 4h. Closing this thread for active paging; will update in-channel when we have the reconciliation write results.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 status: mitigation in progress.
